initial_training_contract.architecture: Qwen3 family; choose either Base or Instruct consistently, report them separately if both
initial_training_contract.learning_rate: tune once on pilot development groups, freeze before confirmatory tests
initial_training_contract.optimizer_state: reset at main C; inherited state as separate deployment control
initial_training_contract.matched_materials: exact A/B multiset for history-only experiment; same number of supervised tokens and effective steps for intervention study
initial_training_contract.cost_note: 2,160 pilot and 9,600 main C updates exclude A/B training, interventions, diagnostics, evaluation, and reruns; GPU hours must be measured on target hardware

primary_endpoints.AULC: mean over fixed C update budget of absolute L(H,C,b)
primary_endpoints.AULG: mean over fixed C update budget of L(H,C,b)-L(H,C,0)
primary_endpoints.historical_main_contrast: Blocked versus Interleaved on C2 AULG and AULC, with history-by-C relation interaction
primary_endpoints.interventional_main_contrast: RCP versus Random on C2 AULG, compared against QBC
required_secondary: steps to threshold with right censoring
total GPU wall time, tokens and probe/teacher cost
primary_endpoints.ceiling_warning: AULG can prefer low starting scores due to headroom; always show the absolute C curve and pre-test.

statistics.recommended_analysis: hierarchical bootstrap by rule family or mixed-effects history × C relation, 95% intervals; preregister primary contrasts and multiplicity hierarchy
statistics.current_ability_matching: randomize histories first; report entire sample; development-only preregistered sensitivity subset; never postselect successful C test branches
statistics.power_note: pilot estimates variance; main extension from 4 to 8–12 rule families decided by power/precision, not test performance

scientific_go_stop.go: E1 matched-current-ability future learning effect replicates and E3 randomized rescue alters learning trajectory beyond QBC / cost controls across heldout families
scientific_go_stop.mechanism_only: E1 effect replicates but RCP is no better than QBC; submit phenomenon and mechanism without new algorithm novelty
scientific_go_stop.merge_I9: only A/B order endpoint/known C target loss differs, no distinct future response after direct-transfer and optimizer controls
scientific_go_stop.merge_I10: only Wsep or original task generalization improves; C future learning does not
scientific_go_stop.stop: effect depends on oracle leakage, posthoc seed selection, unequal budget or a single template
